candidate_captures.reference_policy_note: Source-derived selected policies: CPU auto resolves to F16, but CPU dtype_input only rounds BF16 and TQ is not in q8::has_dot, so TQ matrices use F32 inputs; the separate Q6_K lm_head is a one-row decode operation and uses block-int16. CPU selected HF reference is F32 internal/TQ linears, literal F16 lm_head inputs, and logical F16 K/V. MI50 auto/F16 TQ rows/eligible tiles and the one-row Q6_K head use block-int16; its selected HF reference uses literal F16 inputs for all Linear operations and logical F16 K/V. This is source-derived reference policy, not completed/qualified evidence. The existing F32-matrix/F16KV HF run remains the KV-only control/quality companion, not the MI50 selected-policy gate. Explicit F32 uses F32 matrices and F32 KV. Compare only after genuine completed per-cell references and receipts are independently verified.
